Card Q&A.a: It triggers at the timing when this card is in the trash and your level 6 Digimon with [Pulsemon] in its text is played. [Trash] means that an effect can trigger and activate when the card is in the trash.
Card Q&A.q: When exactly is the timing when this card's [Trash] [Your Turn] effect triggers?

If the "if a Tamer is in this Digimon's digivolution cards" condition is met, do I gain 1 memory and  from this card's [When Digivolving] effect even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?

Effect: [Trash] [Your Turn] When one of your level 6 Digimon with [Pulsemon] in its text is played, 2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into this card.

[When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -16000 DP for the turn. If DNA digivolving, you may set the memory to 3 on your opponent's side. Then, if a Tamer card is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, gain 1 memory and ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞.
[When Attacking] By trashing the top card of your security stack, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack.
